annotations.title: Book a property viewing (no account needed)

description: Request a viewing of an OpenMoov property on behalf of the user — no account required. Requires the property id plus the user's real name, email and UK phone number (the agent uses these to confirm the appointment). Optionally pass preferred_days (e.g. ["Saturday","Sunday"]), preferred_time_of_day (e.g. "morning", "afternoon", "evening") and a short message. Creates a real lead an agent will act on — only call with genuine user details and explicit intent. IMPORTANT: some listings are by PRIVATE OWNERS (listedBy "private_owner" on search/details results). For those, first ask the user whether their name and phone number may be shared with the private owner to arrange the viewing, and pass consent_to_share_details: true only if they agree — without it the request is handled by OpenMoov customer service instead of reaching the owner directly. Returns a viewing_request_id and a status_token: KEEP BOTH, check_viewing_status needs them.

consent_to_share_details.description: Set true ONLY after the user explicitly agrees their name and phone may be shared with the property's private owner to arrange the viewing. Needed for listedBy "private_owner" listings to reach the owner directly; ignored for agent listings.

email.description: The user's email — the agent confirms by email

preferred_days.description: Days that suit the user, e.g. ["Saturday","Sunday"]

name: book_viewing
